description: Use when the user asks for an overview of what is inside a rectangular area (a bounding box). Returns counts for the area: tenements (live, pending, dead), mines (MINEDEX), known deposits, open-file drillholes, company drillhole and surface geochemistry and GSWA geochemistry (count and maximum Au), WAMEX reports, past exploration activity and land-access constraints (conservation reserves, native title, pastoral leases), plus a mapUrl. export_data with the same bbox returns the rows behind a count.

metal.description: Optional; filters known deposits to this commodity (Au, Cu, Ni, W, Sn, Co, Ta, Mn, REE)

name: inspect_region
title: Inspect a region
